env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME CAP, acme_cap. Each site that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.
env.purpose: Your app's id in the App library, like acme_cap for the prefix ACME CAP

env.name: CAP_MESSAGE_URL
env.about: Your message gateway's address, your key in it if it takes one: it is posted the customer's phone and the code. With none, a customer is added with no code.
env.purpose: Your message gateway's address, to send a customer their code

env.name: PP_LINE_ATTRIBUTE
env.about: The site's line attribute that holds the warranty reference. With none, the line goes on with no reference.
env.purpose: The line attribute that holds the warranty reference
